description: Doctrine-transfer conversations for the same SSL session pipeline in domains outside the primary suite. Each conversation returns to its theme across at least seven turns so a candidate can recur and earn promotion without a planted signal. Results are reported per domain rather than collapsed into one score.

turns.question: I am designing a new digital literacy module for lower-secondary students. Where should I start?
How should I handle large differences in students' prior knowledge?
Which learning activities work best for this topic?
How do I assess whether students genuinely understand it instead of merely repeating it?
How do I include students who have little digital support at home?
How do I make sure colleagues actually adopt the module?
What most often goes wrong in curriculum renewal projects like this?
We want to encourage teenagers to drink fewer energy drinks. How should we design the campaign?
Which message works better than simply saying that energy drinks are unhealthy?
Which channels actually reach this group?
How do we measure whether the campaign works?
How do we avoid reaching mainly the teenagers who are already health-conscious?
What role should schools and parents play?
What most often goes wrong in lifestyle campaigns like this?
Our municipality wants a climate-adaptation plan for heavy rainfall and flooding. Where should we start?
Which measures provide the most impact per euro?
How should we involve residents in the choices?
How do we finance the plan over several years?
Who bears the costs and who receives the benefits of these measures?
How do we keep the plan durable across changes in local government?
What most often goes wrong in adaptation plans like this?
